notes.title: One Watcher has been released
notes.notes:
Hello World,

We are super excited to present you One Watcher! Our game has been in development for 8 long years and we are really proud to finally be able to share it with you. It's challenging and unique; something that isn't made with Unreal or Unity - and hopefully something you might fall in love with!

We are excited about the months to come since we will be adding new content and incorporating your feedback to make our 2D platformer even better. Stay tuned and enjoy playing!
